newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hamburg air cargo falls eight pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hamburg air cargo falls eight pct in 1996.

text.p: Total air cargo at Hamburg airport (HAM) fell eight percent to 65,250 tonnes in 1996, airport authority Flughafen Hamburg GmbH said.
Flown air cargo dropped three percent to 36,466 tonnes and trucked cargo slumped 13.7 percent to 28,784 tonnes, a market research department report said.
"Freight was characterised in the first half of the year by a sharp fall in trucked cargo due to the partial relocation of truck handling to Norderstedt," the report noted.
"In the second half of the year volumes were able to be partly brought back to the airport," it added.
